value: 12 ommatidia in the compound eyes of the holotype male (the sentence does not say per eye or both eyes)
conditions: New species described from a male holotype (ICN 099808; Vaupés department, Mitú, km 16 on the Mitú-Monfort road, Cucura, Colombia, 10 Aug. 2019, Winkler extraction, 48 h) and one female paratype (ICN 099807; Villa Fatima, Pie de Cerro Tipiaca, 19 Mar. 2020). The eye sentence sits in the Head paragraph of the holotype male description; the paper gives no separate eye count for the female, whose description refers back to the male. The Diagnosis and Comments do not mention eyes for this species. The key to Metopiellus species uses eye size as a character for other species (M. aglenus eyes absent; M. painensis eyes small or almost absent; M. hirtus eyes small; M. silvaticus eyes almost absent). Not a cave record: forest leaf-litter sample.

conditions: Known only from the female holotype (DHMECN 14489, adult; Quinshull, Chical, Carchi Province, Ecuador, 2 Aug. 2017; fixed in formalin, stored in 75% ethanol); the Description is of that single specimen. The Diagnosis contrasts eye size with congeners: eyes moderate in size (small in O. parvipes; small and laterally orientated in O. maritima) and, set against O. berlini, 'relatively large protruding eyes' belong to O. berlini. A further Ecuadorian specimen (FHGO 9642, Esmeraldas) is treated as O. aff. villamizariorum and is not described.
